verses.original: οὖν Εἴ τις παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης εἴ τις κοινωνία Πνεύματος εἴ τις σπλάγχνα καὶ οἰκτιρμοί
verses.transliteration: oun Ei tis paraklēsis en Christō ei ti paramythion agapēs ei tis koinōnia Pneumatos ei tis splanchna kai oiktirmoi
verses.literal: Therefore if [you have] any encouragement in Christ if any comfort from [His] love if any fellowship with [the] Spirit if any affection and compassion

verses.original: μου τὴν χαρὰν πληρώσατέ ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ φρονῆτε ἔχοντες τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγάπην σύμψυχοι φρονοῦντες τὸ ἓν
verses.transliteration: mou tēn charan plērōsate hina to auto phronēte echontes tēn autēn agapēn sympsychoi phronountes to hen
verses.literal: [then] {make} my - joy complete - vvv vvv by being like-minded having the same love being united in spirit [and] vvv vvv purpose

verses.original: μηδὲν κατ’ ἐριθείαν μηδὲ κατὰ κενοδοξίαν ἀλλὰ τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ ἡγούμενοι ἀλλήλους ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν
verses.transliteration: mēden kat’ eritheian mēde kata kenodoxian alla tē tapeinophrosynē hēgoumenoi allēlous hyperechontas heautōn
verses.literal: [Do] nothing out of selfish ambition or - empty pride but - in humility consider others more important than yourselves

verses.original: ἕκαστοι σκοποῦντες μὴ ἑαυτῶν τὰ ἀλλὰ ἕκαστοι καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων
verses.transliteration: hekastoi skopountes mē heautōn ta alla hekastoi kai ta heterōn
verses.literal: Each [of you] should look not only {to} your own interests but - also to the interests of others

verses.original: φρονεῖτε Τοῦτο ἐν ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: phroneite Touto en hymin ho kai en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: Let this mind be . . . in you which [was] also in Christ Jesus

verses.original: Ὃς ὑπάρχων ἐν μορφῇ Θεοῦ οὐχ ἡγήσατο τὸ εἶναι ἴσα Θεῷ ἁρπαγμὸν
verses.transliteration: Hos hyparchōn en morphē Theou ouch hēgēsato to einai isa Theō harpagmon
verses.literal: Who existing in [the] form of God {did} not consider - vvv equality with God something to be grasped

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ἐκένωσεν ἑαυτὸν λαβών μορφὴν δούλου γενόμενος ἐν ὁμοιώματι ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: alla ekenōsen heauton labōn morphēn doulou genomenos en homoiōmati anthrōpōn
verses.literal: but emptied Himself taking [the] form of a servant being made in human likeness . . .

verses.original: καὶ εὑρεθεὶς σχήματι ὡς ἄνθρωπος ἐταπείνωσεν ἑαυτὸν γενόμενος ὑπήκοος μέχρι θανάτου δὲ θανάτου σταυροῦ
verses.transliteration: kai heuretheis schēmati hōs anthrōpos etapeinōsen heauton genomenos hypēkoos mechri thanatou de thanatou staurou
verses.literal: And being found in appearance as a man He humbled Himself [and] became obedient to death even death on [a] cross

verses.original: Διὸ καὶ ὁ Θεὸς ὑπερύψωσεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐχαρίσατο αὐτῷ τὸ ὄνομα ὑπὲρ πᾶν τὸ ὄνομα
verses.transliteration: Dio kai ho Theos hyperypsōsen auton kai echarisato autō to onoma hyper pan to onoma
verses.literal: Therefore - - God exalted Him {to the highest place} and gave Him the name above all - names

verses.original: ἵνα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ πᾶν γόνυ κάμψῃ ἐπουρανίων καὶ ἐπιγείων καὶ καταχθονίων
verses.transliteration: hina en tō onomati Iēsou pan gony kampsē epouraniōn kai epigeiōn kai katachthoniōn
verses.literal: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow in heaven and on earth and under the earth

verses.original: καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσηται ὅτι ΙΗΣΟΥΣ ΧΡΙΣΤΟΣ ΚΥΡΙΟΣ εἰς δόξαν Θεοῦ Πατρός
verses.transliteration: kai pasa glōssa exomologēsētai hoti IĒSOUS CHRISTOS KYRIOS eis doxan Theou Patros
verses.literal: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ [is] Lord to [the] glory of God [the] Father

verses.original: Ὥστε μου ἀγαπητοί καθὼς πάντοτε ὑπηκούσατε μὴ μόνον ὡς ἐν μου τῇ παρουσίᾳ ἀλλὰ νῦν πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἐν μου τῇ ἀπουσίᾳ κατεργάζεσθε ἑαυτῶν τὴν σωτηρίαν μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου
verses.transliteration: Hōste mou agapētoi kathōs pantote hypēkousate mē monon hōs en mou tē parousia alla nyn pollō mallon en mou tē apousia katergazesthe heautōn tēn sōtērian meta phobou kai tromou
verses.literal: Therefore my beloved just as vvv you have always obeyed not only - in my - presence but now even more in my - absence continue to work out your - salvation with fear and trembling

verses.original: γάρ ἐστιν Θεὸς ὁ ἐνεργῶν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ τὸ θέλειν καὶ τὸ ἐνεργεῖν ὑπὲρ τῆς εὐδοκίας
verses.transliteration: gar estin Theos ho energōn en hymin kai to thelein kai to energein hyper tēs eudokias
verses.literal: For it is God who works in you - - to will and - to act on behalf of [His] good purpose

verses.original: ποιεῖτε Πάντα χωρὶς γογγυσμῶν καὶ διαλογισμῶν
verses.transliteration: poieite Panta chōris gongysmōn kai dialogismōn
verses.literal: Do everything without complaining [or] arguing

verses.original: ἵνα γένησθε ἄμεμπτοι καὶ ἀκέραιοι τέκνα Θεοῦ ἄμωμα μέσον σκολιᾶς καὶ διεστραμμένης γενεᾶς ἐν οἷς φαίνεσθε ὡς φωστῆρες ἐν κόσμῳ
verses.transliteration: hina genēsthe amemptoi kai akeraioi tekna Theou amōma meson skolias kai diestrammenēs geneas en hois phainesthe hōs phōstēres en kosmō
verses.literal: so that you may be blameless and pure children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation in which you shine as lights in [the] world

verses.original: ἐπέχοντες λόγον ζωῆς εἰς ἐμοὶ καύχημα εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ ὅτι οὐκ ἔδραμον εἰς κενὸν οὐδὲ ἐκοπίασα εἰς κενὸν
verses.transliteration: epechontes logon zōēs eis emoi kauchēma eis hēmeran Christou hoti ouk edramon eis kenon oude ekopiasa eis kenon
verses.literal: as you hold forth [the] word of life in order that I may boast on [the] day of Christ that vvv I did not run - - [or] labor in vain

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ καὶ εἰ σπένδομαι ἐπὶ τῇ θυσίᾳ καὶ λειτουργίᾳ τῆς ὑμῶν πίστεως χαίρω καὶ συνχαίρω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Alla kai ei spendomai epi tē thysia kai leitourgia tēs hymōn pisteōs chairō kai synchairō pasin hymin
verses.literal: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith I am glad and rejoice with all of you

verses.original: τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ ὑμεῖς καὶ χαίρετε καὶ συνχαίρετέ μοι
verses.transliteration: to de auto hymeis kai chairete kai synchairete moi
verses.literal: - - So you too should be glad and rejoice with me

verses.original: δὲ Ἐλπίζω ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ πέμψαι Τιμόθεον ὑμῖν ταχέως ἵνα κἀγὼ εὐψυχῶ γνοὺς τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: de Elpizō en Kyriō Iēsou pempsai Timotheon hymin tacheōs hina kagō eupsychō gnous ta peri hymōn
verses.literal: Now I hope in [the] Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon that I also may be cheered when I learn . . . how you {are doing}

verses.original: γὰρ ἔχω οὐδένα ἰσόψυχον ὅστις γνησίως μεριμνήσει ὑμῶν τὰ περὶ
verses.transliteration: gar echō oudena isopsychon hostis gnēsiōs merimnēsei hymōn ta peri
verses.literal: - I have nobody else like him who {will} genuinely care for your needs . . .

verses.original: γὰρ πάντες οἱ ζητοῦσιν ἑαυτῶν τὰ οὐ τὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar pantes hoi zētousin heautōn ta ou ta Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: For all the [others] look after their own interests not those of Jesus Christ

verses.original: δὲ γινώσκετε αὐτοῦ τὴν δοκιμὴν ὅτι ὡς τέκνον πατρὶ ἐδούλευσεν σὺν ἐμοὶ εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον
verses.transliteration: de ginōskete autou tēn dokimēn hoti hōs teknon patri edouleusen syn emoi eis to euangelion
verses.literal: But you know [Timothy’s] - proven worth that as a child [with his] father he has served with me to [advance] the gospel

verses.original: οὖν μὲν ἐλπίζω πέμψαι Τοῦτον ἐξαυτῆς ὡς ἂν ἀφίδω τὰ περὶ ἐμὲ
verses.transliteration: oun men elpizō pempsai Touton exautēs hōs an aphidō ta peri eme
verses.literal: So . . . I hope to send him as soon as . . . . . . I see what happens with me

verses.original: δὲ πέποιθα ἐν Κυρίῳ ὅτι αὐτὸς καὶ ἐλεύσομαι ταχέως
verses.transliteration: de pepoitha en Kyriō hoti autos kai eleusomai tacheōs
verses.literal: And I trust in [the] Lord that I myself . . . will come soon

verses.original: δὲ ἡγησάμην Ἀναγκαῖον πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς Ἐπαφρόδιτον μου τὸν ἀδελφὸν καὶ συνεργὸν καὶ συστρατιώτην δὲ ὑμῶν ἀπόστολον καὶ λειτουργὸν μου τῆς χρείας
verses.transliteration: de hēgēsamēn Anankaion pempsai pros hymas Epaphroditon mou ton adelphon kai synergon kai systratiōtēn de hymōn apostolon kai leitourgon mou tēs chreias
verses.literal: But I thought [it] necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus my - brother - fellow worker and fellow soldier [who is] also your messenger and minister to my - needs

verses.original: ἐπειδὴ ἦν ἐπιποθῶν πάντας ὑμᾶς καὶ ἀδημονῶν διότι ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἠσθένησεν
verses.transliteration: epeidē ēn epipothōn pantas hymas kai adēmonōn dioti ēkousate hoti ēsthenēsen
verses.literal: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard - he was ill

verses.original: γὰρ ἠσθένησεν καὶ παραπλήσιον θανάτῳ ἀλλὰ ὁ Θεὸς ἠλέησεν αὐτόν δὲ οὐκ μόνον αὐτὸν ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐμέ ἵνα μὴ σχῶ λύπην ἐπὶ λύπην
verses.transliteration: gar ēsthenēsen kai paraplēsion thanatō alla ho Theos ēleēsen auton de ouk monon auton alla kai eme hina mē schō lypēn epi lypēn
verses.literal: vvv He was sick indeed nearly unto death But - God had mercy on him and not only on him but also on me to vvv spare me sorrow upon sorrow

verses.original: οὖν Σπουδαιοτέρως ἔπεμψα αὐτὸν ἵνα ἰδόντες αὐτὸν πάλιν χαρῆτε κἀγὼ ὦ ἀλυπότερος
verses.transliteration: oun Spoudaioterōs epempsa auton hina idontes auton palin charēte kagō ō alypoteros
verses.literal: Therefore {I am} all the more eager to send him so that when you see him again you may rejoice and I may be less anxious

verses.original: οὖν προσδέχεσθε αὐτὸν ἐν Κυρίῳ μετὰ πάσης χαρᾶς καὶ ἔχετε ἐντίμους τοὺς τοιούτους
verses.transliteration: oun prosdechesthe auton en Kyriō meta pasēs charas kai echete entimous tous toioutous
verses.literal: - Welcome him in [the] Lord with great joy and vvv honor - men [like him]

verses.original: ὅτι ἤγγισεν μέχρι θανάτου διὰ τὸ ἔργον Χριστοῦ παραβολευσάμενος τῇ ψυχῇ ἵνα ἀναπληρώσῃ ὑμῶν τὸ ὑστέρημα τῆς λειτουργίας πρός με
verses.transliteration: hoti ēngisen mechri thanatou dia to ergon Christou paraboleusamenos tē psychē hina anaplērōsē hymōn to hysterēma tēs leitourgias pros me
verses.literal: because he nearly - died for the work of Christ risking [his] life - to make up for your - deficit of service to me
